ctx.x: So, who were the great pimps from New Orleans?

Fast Life Eddie. Treacherous Slim. In fact, Fast Life Eddie is still alive today. Fast Life Eddie is in his 90s. And then there was a guy by the name of Whispering Boots who was an elderly pimp. And there was Big Coochie who was a heavyset guy but another golden tongue type character but stayed immaculate, neat, weighed about 250 to 300 pounds all the time. Then there was Gray Eye. Gray Eye was a pimp. Gray Eye owned a lot of load. He always kept a flashy automobile. He just died here about four or five years ago…
